description: This file contains code for integrating and fetching social media feeds, specifically from Twitter and Facebook, into SuiteCRM. It manages OAuth authentication, fetches tweets and Facebook posts, processes content, and inserts relevant data into the 'sugarfeed' database table.

methods.name: check_facebook_login
methods.description: Checks if the user is logged into Facebook via the helper and retrieves the newsfeed data.

methods.name: data_insert
methods.description: Inserts a Facebook feed item into the 'sugarfeed' table if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: guid_maker
methods.description: Generates a GUID/UUID for database record insertion.

methods.name: generate_stream
methods.description: Processes Facebook stream data to create formatted content for insertion or display.
